title: Speech Generation Speaker Poisoning: Capability Erasure in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
abstract: arXiv:2603.07551v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent zero-shot Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems can clone previously unseen voices from only a few seconds of audio. We formulate Speech Generation Speaker Poisoning (SGSP), a task that seeks to prevent a model from synthesizing targeted speaker identities while maintaining performance on all other speakers. Unlike conventional machine unlearning, removing training examples is insufficient because modern zero-shot TTS systems can reconstruct identities through learned speaker representations and strong generalization capabilities. We evaluate both inference-time filtering and parameter-modification approaches across settings involving 1, 15, and 100 forget speakers, focusing primarily on speakers seen during training, which we show are harder to suppress than unseen speakers. translated_title: 语音生成说话人投毒：零样本文本转语音中的能力擦除
translated_abstract: 近期的零样本文本转语音（TTS）系统仅需几秒钟的音频即可克隆先前未见过的声音。我们提出了语音生成说话人投毒（SGSP）这一任务，旨在阻止模型合成特定目标说话人的身份，同时保持其在所有其他说话人上的性能。与传统的机器遗忘不同，仅仅移除训练样本是不够的，因为现代零样本TTS系统可以通过学习到的说话人表示和强大的泛化能力重建说话人身份。我们在涉及1个、15个和100个遗忘说话人的设置中评估了推理时过滤和参数修改两类方法，重点关注训练期间见过的说话人，我们证明这些说话人比未见过的说话人更难被抑制。为了刻画效用与隐私之间的权衡，我们引入了一个基于AUC分析的评估框架，并提出了遗忘集相似度指标。
tldr: 该论文提出了语音生成说话人投毒（SGSP）新任务，通过推理时过滤和参数修改两类方法阻止零样本TTS模型合成特定说话人的声音，并提出基于AUC分析的评估框架来刻画效用与隐私的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates Speech Generation Speaker Poisoning (SGSP), a novel task that prevents zero-shot TTS models from synthesizing targeted speaker identities while preserving performance on other speakers, and introduces an AUC-based evaluation framework to characterize the utility-privacy trade-off.
